name: Ori
source:
Ori is a bubbly and shy young woman. Though she can be assertive and headstrong when she wants to be. She appears to know Erin, but Erin doesn't remember her.

[From [url=https://foxpancakes.itch.io/its-a-promise]Itch.io[/url]]
